resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list calls the mountain Brush Mountain; the register and the Forest Lookouts page say Brushy Mountain. The register number US 1728, VA 30 matches, so it is one entry.

notes_for_editor: Build year and registration are from the register. Removal is only shown as 'Removed' (Forest Lookouts) and 'Tower Gone' (Association list); neither gives a date or cause. One WebSearch found nothing more, and the register has no removal field. Next check: Jefferson National Forest or Forest Service records. The Alleghany Brushy Mountain (US 923, VA 9) is a separate tower and was not used. The brief's status 'gone' matches the sources. The name's origin (Allen Field) is not in any source read, so the story does not explain it.
